snippet.title: Fate/Grand Order [Third Singularity: Okeanos] PV
snippet.description:
Get ready to set sail during the Age of Exploration 
with the newest chapter of the Fate series--Third Singularity: Sealed Ends of the Four Seas, Okeanos!
                                                                            
The third Grand Order is set in 1573.

This is the Age of Exploration where many pirates give their lives for endless treasures. In this sealed sea called Okeanos, due to the incineration of humanity, legendary pirates will risk everything for the greatest treasure, the Holy Grail. The newest chapter of Fate/Grand Order is unveiled! 

For more information, visit: www.Fate-go.us
